title: Unique Aerated Malaysian Rhubarb Satay
description: A tangy and aerated Malaysian dish featuring forced rhubarb, perfect for a weeknight dinner, this keto friendly satay is a unique twist on traditional Malaysian cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high heat.
In a blender, combine coconut milk, peanut oil, lime juice, ginger paste, garlic paste, salt, and black pepper, and blend until smooth.
In a large bowl, whisk together the blended mixture and egg whites until stiff peaks form.
Fold in the manteca until well combined.
Add the cut rhubarb to the bowl and toss to coat with the aerated mixture.
Thread the rhubarb pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the satay for 8-10 minutes, turning frequently, until the rhubarb is tender and lightly charred.
Serve the satay hot, garnished with fresh cilantro and lime wedges.
